description: This file defines an interface 'IStreamFailureHandler' within the Orleans.Streams namespace, specifying methods for handling stream failure scenarios such as delivery failures and subscription failures, including configuration property 'ShouldFaultSubsriptionOnError'.

methods.name: OnDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Handles actions to be taken when delivery of an event to a consumer has failed after all retries.

methods.name: OnSubscriptionFailure
methods.description: Handles actions to be taken when establishing a subscription has failed.
